MCP risk and threat-model admission plus fail-closed connector-result release governance
MCP structured logging with durable audit/receipt records plus fail-closed recovery planning and authoritative plan receipts

effect_evidence.rationale: The manifest classifies KA-004 as pure or advisory and declares no authoritative effect port.

effect_evidence.rationale: The manifest classifies KA-005 as pure or advisory and declares no authoritative effect port.

security_evidence.rationale: The semantic and owning-path proofs show a declared adversarial pattern causes a fail-closed L1 veto.

effect_evidence.rationale: The manifest classifies KA-061 as pure or advisory and declares no authoritative effect port.

security_evidence.rationale: The production owning-path proof shows normalized input and committed classification are consumed, required failures block, and KA-113 may raise but never lower the independent DMRF tier.

effect_evidence.rationale: The manifest classifies KA-113 as pure or advisory and declares no authoritative effect port.

security_evidence.rationale: The owning path proves the complete orchestration decision is consumed before provider work and the owning job alone binds the admitted transition receipt.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-032 proposes orchestration only; SimulationJobRunner owns the running-state transition and binds it to an idempotent SHA-256 receipt.

security_evidence.rationale: The owning job applies the allocation as a hard token ceiling and blocks plans whose effective allocation cannot cover the declared provider-call plan.

effect_evidence.rationale: The manifest classifies KA-037 as pure or advisory; it allocates a limit while SimulationJobRunner alone enforces it.

security_evidence.rationale: The deterministic local projection performs no authorization, provider call, persistence, connector, or infrastructure effect.

effect_evidence.rationale: The manifest classifies KA-042 as pure or advisory and the owning job only consumes its bounded projection as context.

security_evidence.rationale: The graph projection must consume KA-042, remain content bounded, and enter provider context only through the simulation owner.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-070 does not call a provider; SimulationJobRunner owns application of the projection and binds that action to the canonical KA plan.

security_evidence.rationale: The owning path proves the bounded estimate is injected into KA-1081 and cannot be bypassed by a duplicate admission estimate.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-1080 performs arithmetic over caller-supplied estimates and neither measures nor reserves resources.

security_evidence.rationale: The semantic proof shows a dependency-supplied over-budget estimate blocks admission even when duplicate direct estimates claim a smaller request.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-1081 returns a deterministic admission decision and explicitly starts no execution.

security_evidence.rationale: Content-addressed proposals remain write-free until SimulationJobRunner authorizes artifact persistence and binds the exact request and result hashes.

effect_evidence.rationale: The KA produces no artifact; the owning service performs persistence and issues the authoritative idempotent receipt.

security_evidence.rationale: The owning MCP admission path consumes deterministic secret findings and blocks inline credentials before connector execution.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-137 performs bounded local discovery only; the MCP route owns the fail-closed admission decision and performs no effect when findings are present.

security_evidence.rationale: The production MCP owner consumes the policy decision and fails closed before a connector call when required consent is absent.

effect_evidence.rationale: The MCP route alone performs the connector effect and binds its receipt to the admission plan and KA-177 policy proposal.

security_evidence.rationale: The production MCP owner consumes the bounded access decision and blocks a denied principal before connector execution.

effect_evidence.rationale: The MCP route owns the connector call and binds the authoritative effect receipt to the admission plan and KA-179 access proposal.

security_evidence.rationale: The MCP result owner consumes the bounded heuristic and exposes a human-review requirement without treating the score as external truth.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-010 is a bounded advisory heuristic; the MCP owner applies only the release metadata and the KA performs no effect.

security_evidence.rationale: The production MCP owner consumes the bounded risk result and blocks write, delete, or admin scopes that require mitigation before connector execution.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-022 computes risk only; the MCP route owns the pre-effect admission decision.

security_evidence.rationale: The production L8 TruthGate consumes the bounded trust/risk veto and blocks response release when the declared risk exceeds policy.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-024 returns a deterministic gate decision; the governed owner applies the release block and the KA performs no effect.

security_evidence.rationale: The production MCP owner consumes declared trust-boundary findings and blocks an insecure connector flow before execution.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-136 evaluates declared architecture only; the MCP owner applies the fail-closed admission decision.

security_evidence.rationale: The MCP result owner requires the declared control audit to pass and blocks release when result-governance evidence fails.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-175 audits declared control evidence only; the owning route applies the response-release decision.

security_evidence.rationale: A trusted prompt-injection signal becomes a causal threat alert that blocks the connector result before response release.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-182 proposes containment but applies no action; the MCP owner only blocks response release and records the already-applied connector effect separately.

security_evidence.rationale: The MCP owner emits only a content-free structured record and binds its exact hashes to the durable execution ledger without retaining connector content or credentials.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-096 validates structured logging metadata and performs no effect; StructuredLoggingService owns emission and supplies the separately reviewed authoritative receipt.

security_evidence.rationale: The content-free audit proposal is persisted by AppAuditService with a database identity, stable proposal hash, and owner receipt while connector result content remains absent.

effect_evidence.rationale: The retained authority classifies KA-097 proposal construction as advisory; AppAuditService, not the KA, applies the durable audit record and binds its receipt.

security_evidence.rationale: A real MCP route failure invokes the fault-tolerance owner, persists its fail-closed circuit and fallback decision, and never performs an automatic retry.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-106 returns a bounded recovery recommendation only; the MCP owner records the plan and explicitly leaves automatic retry disabled.

security_evidence.rationale: The recovery caller preserves the incident identity, proposed response order, zero applied actions, and no automatic retry in the durable MCP execution record.

effect_evidence.rationale: MCPRecoveryLedger records the proposed recovery plan with an idempotent SHA-256 receipt; it does not claim containment, notification, eradication, or recovery steps were applied.

security_evidence.rationale: The post-call owner supplies only measured latency, consumes the bounded decision, and records no provider content, credential, invented quality label, or notification effect.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-084 returns a measured monitoring decision and alert recommendation only; notification_applied remains false and the already-completed provider call retains its pre-call plan identity.

security_evidence.rationale: The pre-call owner sends only element IDs, token counts, priorities, and content references through the KA lifecycle, requires system and final-user context, and fails closed when required context exceeds budget.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-1072 selects context without calling a provider; ProviderGatewayService owns the external call and binds its effect receipt to the unchanged pre-call KA plan.

security_evidence.rationale: The authenticated diagnostics owner supplies only aggregate content-free request measurements and KA-091 returns a renderer-neutral specification without creating an asset.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-091 produces a chart specification only and the manifest declares no authoritative effect port.

security_evidence.rationale: The dashboard blueprint consumes declared aggregate widgets and does not include user content, render a UI, persist state, or start a data stream.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-092 composes a renderer-neutral blueprint and performs no UI, persistence, or streaming effect.

security_evidence.rationale: The authenticated diagnostics owner passes only allowlisted section names; no diagnostic values, user content, recipient, or external destination enters the report plan.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-094 explicitly reports that no artifact was created and no distribution occurred; a future reporting service would own those effects.

security_evidence.rationale: The owner supplies a bounded status code rather than exception or user content, and the healthy-path decision proposes and delivers no alert.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-095 may recommend an alert but alert_triggered remains false and no delivery receipt exists; the owning alert service is not invoked in this read-only diagnostics path.

security_evidence.rationale: KA-098 receives only already-measured route aggregates, creates no profile dump, and never attaches a hidden profiler.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-098 computes deterministic aggregates from caller-supplied measurements and performs no collection or persistence effect.

security_evidence.rationale: The semantic and owner proofs cover sensitive-key redaction, caller-supplied aggregate metrics, no live-frame inspection, no traceback capture, and no remote debug port.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-099 normalizes an in-memory diagnostic snapshot and performs no capture, port, persistence, or external telemetry effect.

security_evidence.rationale: The authenticated owner derives bounded load only from in-flight request counts and a declared local concurrency reference; it exposes no request content or host process data.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-100 returns a capacity recommendation only and explicitly applies no JIT, garbage collection, thread-pool, memory, or runtime mutation.

security_evidence.rationale: SecureAcquisitionSession supplies bounded content-free local-file metadata; KA-071 admits only the supported source type and LocalKnowledgeIngestionService validates the full chain before materialization.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-071 returns an unapplied proposal; LocalKnowledgeIngestionService binds that proposal to an idempotent SHA-256 authoritative receipt in the same transaction that commits the ingestion job and outbox work.

security_evidence.rationale: The stage consumes only KA-071 output and performs shallow whitespace trimming, null-field removal, and exact canonical-JSON deduplication without fuzzy or statistical claims.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-072 is a pure in-memory metadata cleaning stage with no authoritative effect port.

security_evidence.rationale: The owner proves KA-073 consumes KA-072, normalizes only declared secure-ingestion metadata types, records conversion failures, and preserves the authoritative record chain hash.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-073 performs a bounded in-memory metadata transformation and has no authoritative effect port.

security_evidence.rationale: Validation is fail closed at the owner boundary, checks required local-file metadata, returns content-free quarantine summaries, and prevents any SQL, vector, graph, object, or outbox materialization on rejection.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-074 returns an admission decision only; LocalKnowledgeIngestionService owns all later effects.

security_evidence.rationale: The production owner requests the explicit knowledge_source schema, consumes KA-074 valid records, and anchors the validated plan identity in persisted node metadata.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-075 performs explicit in-memory field alignment and has no persistence effect port.

security_evidence.rationale: Resolution uses deterministic exact keys, never runtime object identity or fuzzy matching, and rejects same-key conflicting records before the owner can materialize them.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-076 returns a bounded exact-resolution decision and performs no merge or persistence effect.

security_evidence.rationale: The stage reports zero external calls and no providers, performs deterministic local topic and industry inference only, and never fabricates geospatial coordinates.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-077 applies only local in-memory advisory fields and has no provider or persistence effect port.

security_evidence.rationale: Fresh ingestion explicitly disables archival; the stage consumes the final dependency, reports zero eligible or archived records, and does not claim compression, encryption, deletion, or storage effects.

effect_evidence.rationale: The manifest declares no KA-078 effect port; its archive output is proposal-only and the ingestion receipt deliberately excludes the archive proposal identity.

security_evidence.rationale: The provider owner rejects a tampered claim that training started and leaves the admission store untouched; app-owned path and idempotency-reuse tests separately prove containment and no overwrite.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-081 remains proposal-only. ProviderModelLifecycleService alone writes the idempotent admission record and binds that record, not training execution, to an authoritative receipt.

security_evidence.rationale: Evaluation fails closed when prediction and label evidence is absent and computes only measured accuracy and macro classification metrics from equal-length scalar observations.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-082 performs no inference, persistence, provider call, artifact creation, or external effect.

security_evidence.rationale: The owner derives bounded structural records from the app-owned export without retaining prompt or answer content in the durable admission, and the KA rejects nested or non-finite feature values.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-085 applies deterministic in-memory median imputation, standard scaling, and bounded one-hot encoding but creates no artifact and persists no result.

security_evidence.rationale: Candidate ranking consumes exact measured observations only; when measurements are absent the output remains MEASUREMENT_REQUIRED with no synthetic best score.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-086 returns a bounded candidate and ranking proposal with zero provider calls and no tuning effect.

security_evidence.rationale: The provider owner contains artifacts to an app-owned model root, rejects unhealthy measurements and tampered effect claims before persistence, and verifies receipt integrity on replay.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-083 remains proposal-only. ProviderModelLifecycleService writes an idempotent release-preparation record and receipt while explicitly applying no deployment, traffic, rollback, provider, or artifact effect.

security_evidence.rationale: Version proposals consume the owner-measured SHA-256 identity of a contained app-owned artifact and accept no caller path, registry target, tag, or fabricated commit.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-087 proposes semantic version progression and applies no registry write, tag, version assignment, or artifact creation.

security_evidence.rationale: Assignment accepts only a caller-supplied subject hash, validates an exact two-variant 100-percent split, and analyzes only bounded measured counts.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-088 creates an experiment plan and optional measured analysis while leaving activation, persistence, provider calls, assignment, and traffic routing unapplied.

security_evidence.rationale: The proposal binds a contained artifact digest, bounded parameter count, target sparsity, method, and optional content-free importance-profile digest without loading or changing model weights.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-089 reports a requested removal count only and explicitly performs no pruning, weight change, retraining, provider call, quality claim, or artifact creation.

security_evidence.rationale: The proposal consumes the owner-measured artifact size and digest, restricts bit depths and formats, and treats the arithmetic size as a theoretical bound requiring later measurement.

effect_evidence.rationale: KA-090 applies no quantization, calibration, weight change, provider call, or artifact creation and reports no quantized path or measured size.
